text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide receives the URA Senior 
Division Award. When the interviewer asks 
about her leg injury and her sister's 
absence, she falters, struggling for 
words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is invited to a mock race by 
Biwa Hayahide. However, she sensed 
something slightly off about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that if they were to fight, it 
should be on the GⅠ stage, Narita Brian 
turned down the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no way of knowing why Biwa 
Hayahide had extended the invitation...
